notes.title: POSSIBLE FINAL UPDATE
notes.notes:
This is very likely going to be the final update for Atlas Ablaze. Admittedly, I had plans to add additional artwork to the game, but after a while I realized that it feels complete as it is.

     Regardless of me saying this, feel free to let me know if you notice any typos, grammatical errors, bugs, ect. as I'm still willing to update the game if anyone really wants me to clean any other parts of it up. That being said, as a newer game developer, there are some issues that are common within the engine I use that I don't know how to fix.

     Please keep this in mind, because I've tried my best to make a game that works smoothly, but there are certain things I just don't know how to polish. For example, if you skip too often, the game may freeze. If this happens, by the way, you should NOT overwrite your last save in a spot where the game froze. It will not work properly.

     Thank you to anyone who supported my passion project. It means a lot to me.

notes.title: Atlas Ablaze Demo Update
notes.notes:
You read that right, new content is available in the Atlas Ablaze demo! Wooooo!

It should look the same at first glance, but try playing through an entire scene then moving forward to the next scene. There's some sneaky little uh, some sneaky uhm, I snuck some uhhhh stuff in between the main scenes.
And you may be thinking, "It's not sneaky if you tell us about it!" To that I say, you're right. I know. I'm just being dramatic but you should definitely check it out.

I felt like the demo was too lighthearted in comparison to the full game, so I wanted to fix that without dropping any major spoilers. If you play it, tell me what you think!
